scope: Deterministic saved inbox overview and linked-contact count followups in existing project-bound Atlas chats. Other chat and mutation paths remain unchanged.
rootCause: The original model output ignored the correct pageSummary2 and generated3.
Client history contains only user/assistant prose; prior tool results were not replayed for the correction, which generated5.
Raw UTC timestamps were re-labelled as Europe/Stockholm without conversion.

implementation.facts: Existing owner/conversation/project-authorized read RPCs refreshed every report turn; no facts inferred from client assistant prose.
implementation.rendering: Counts computed by existing saved-page summary; source instants rendered by existing Intl-backed Stockholm timezone utility.
implementation.messages: Only latest linked message per contact on returned page, already selected complete text; same version/mailbox/link checks. Excerpts are literal and escaped, not a new inferred decision. No fallback to older selected text for a newer unread message.
implementation.boundary: Conservative read-only intent allowlist, refusing positive write/draft/send/cancel commands. General writing remains on existing model path.
implementation.mailbox: Exactly one existing non-revoked worker mailbox reference; ambiguity/unavailable reads do not produce invented zero counts.

identity: project command center · renders from canonical project data names the project the route resolved, with its slug and stored stop state
settings · Project → Platform → Verified External Account → Credential the rendered surface states the project on every form, and each form sends its own project id

limits: Only the recognised project-bound inbox report/count path gets deterministic rendering. Free-form analysis elsewhere remains model-generated and is not universally verified.
A contact link is not pilot acceptance, recipient-address validation or permission to send.
Counts remain limited to the fetched saved page and configured inbox scope; no whole-mailbox or Sent-folder total.
Latest literal excerpts can contain signatures or quoted earlier email; they are explicitly source excerpts, not a fresh interpretation.
Future dates/recipients, contact holds and customer sending require separate owner decisions.
